_doc: The INLINE-STRUCTURE template (2026-10-31): 'structure' is the cell itself (an object) instead of a materials.json name -- the door
a GUI uses for a cell the user built.  The shape lane G's translator writes: explicit lattice vectors in bohr (the FCC a/2 columns of
Si_diamond's a = 10.26), atoms in fractional coordinates of those vectors, the pseudopotential set from solid.pp (default
gth-lda-valence) and the magnetic decoration in solid.siteSpins, as for a named structure.  Optional 'name' (it names the revisions;
default 'inline') and 'pp'.  It IS Si_diamond: UTCalculation Deck.AnInlineDeckAndItsNamedTwinBuildTheSameFingerprint.
